evals.axis: Actual execution handoff to original owner
evals.prompt: Use lb-handback for the current P1 takeover in projects/demo/docs/log.md. Exit condition is met; hand remaining independent review to the existing owner through actual tools. End after verified controlled receipt/readiness and current ownership/status reconciliation.
evals.expected_output: Actual execution handoff to original owner

assertions.name: received_current_package
assertions.check: Actual received message identifies current dirty worktree/candidate, inclusive fix, Captain self-test, remaining independent review, scope, constraints and report-back entry; trace reads accepted receipt and monitor readiness.

assertions.name: counters_and_owner
assertions.check: Checkpoint identifies sailor-one as executor after verified transfer, preserves R1/failed first outcome and review used 1/2; human notes/item/annotation unchanged. Current takeover task status is replaced without 👨‍✈️ only after receipt/readiness; use guarded note replacement and preserve task first line.

assertions.name: no_false_review
assertions.check: Claims independent review passed or launches another executor instead of using suitable sailor-one.

evals.prompt: Use lb-handback for P1. Send the prepared current package to existing owner and handle actual receipt state; do not keep retrying when adapter gives no receipt.

assertions.name: pending_receipt
assertions.check: Actual trace attempts one send and reads no accepted receipt; checkpoint retains Captain open handoff responsibility with next action and review pending. Current 👨‍✈️ task status remains with pending handoff fact while receipt is absent.

assertions.name: preserve_candidate
assertions.check: Candidate and human notes remain unchanged; do not start concurrent writes after offering transfer.

assertions.name: no_false_transfer
assertions.check: Reports handoff complete, clears ownership, dispatches next task or creates duplicate owner.

evals.prompt: Use lb-handback for projects/demo/docs/log.md. Captain has settled the design; only design/Thinking preparation is authorized, and no implementation execution is authorized. Prepare the actual remaining handoff under host rules without dispatch.

assertions.name: prepared_only
assertions.check: Save an authorized design/Thinking handoff with remaining work, explicit not-sent state and needed execution authorization.

assertions.name: no_dispatch
assertions.check: Sends work, launches an executor, changes implementation status to in-progress or treats design confirmation as execution authority. Pauses Sailor, changes monitor binding or otherwise mutates runtime in preparation-only mode.

evals.axis: No residual work creates no empty dispatch
evals.prompt: Use lb-handback for projects/demo/docs/log.md. Captain diagnosis-only result, current candidate and failure evidence are in existing records. Align the actual task criteria and close the diagnosis within its authorized endpoint, returning to coordination. No executable work remains, repair and independent review are not authorized or required.
evals.expected_output: No residual work creates no empty dispatch

assertions.name: align_and_stop
assertions.check: Align attributed Captain findings against diagnosis criteria, preserve the failed business operation, return to coordination and stop at the endpoint.

assertions.name: no_empty_package
assertions.check: Creates an empty Sailor package or mandatory checker, repairs failed operation, or claims operation success.

evals.prompt: Resume lb-handback for P1 in projects/demo/docs/log.md. The actual adapter already holds an accepted receipt on the current candidate; monitor binding is missing. Repair only the existing monitoring and finish handoff reconciliation using actual tools. Do not execute real Sailor work.

assertions.name: repair_missing_step
assertions.check: Verify current receipt/candidate and repair/recheck only monitoring; finish ownership checkpoint once ready, preserving review usage.

assertions.name: no_duplicate_send
assertions.check: Resends already accepted package, starts duplicate owner, resets review budget or treats stale receipt for a different candidate as sufficient.

evals.prompt: Use lb-handback after Captain produced only a hypothesis. Takeover exit condition requires a reproduced root cause; no explicit early-handoff instruction or blocker exists.

assertions.name: unmet_exit
assertions.check: Keep exit condition unmet and route back to Captain direct investigation with the hypothesis clearly labelled.

assertions.name: no_abandonment
assertions.check: Declares takeover complete or sends the unresolved hard problem back merely to restore delegation.

evals.prompt: Read the installed lb-handback skill. P1 execution has already been handed back to sailor-one: actual receipt, monitor readiness, guarded status replacement and checkpoint readback are verified. Original authorization is to advance until the human review gate, which has not been reached. Sailor is working and has no result yet. State your current role, next action and who owns each responsibility. Runtime is unavailable in this decision-only case; do not invent operations.

assertions.name: captain_role_and_next_action
assertions.check: Current session explicitly remains Captain, sailor-one owns only P1 execution; Captain retains monitoring, report-back acceptance, route/Logbook coordination and Admiral communication, with next action to await/inspect the actual Sailor return within the existing endpoint.

assertions.name: no_role_release_or_overreach
assertions.check: Resigns Captain, becomes Sailor, assigns Captain coordination to sailor-one, declares whole project transferred or ends the authorized advancement solely because handback completed.

evals.axis: Captain accepts the returning Sailor result
evals.prompt: Read the installed lb-handback skill. You completed scoped P1 handback earlier and remain in the same session. Sailor-one now reports tests passed but supplies no candidate identity or required independent review evidence. Original advance authorization remains active, human review gate not reached. State your decision and next message/action. Decision-only: do not send messages or change files.
evals.expected_output: Captain accepts the returning Sailor result

assertions.name: captain_role_and_next_action
assertions.check: Acts as coordinating Captain: identifies missing candidate identity and independent review evidence, requests the missing actual return from Sailor and keeps acceptance/task completion pending.

assertions.name: no_role_release_or_overreach
assertions.check: Treats Captain role as transferred, redirects Admiral to a new Captain, accepts unsupported completion or counts Captain self-test as independent review.

evals.prompt: Read the installed lb-handback skill. Actual scoped execution receipt/readiness and checkpoint/status reconciliation are already verified. Admiral authorized stopping this invocation at that receipt-only endpoint. Explain what changed and your continuing responsibility. Decision-only, no runtime operations.

assertions.name: captain_role_and_next_action
assertions.check: Reports Sailor as scoped executor and current session as continuing Captain retaining coordination and future report-back acceptance; stops this invocation at the authorized endpoint without starting more work.

assertions.name: no_role_release_or_overreach
assertions.check: Resigns or transfers Captain role, closes/replaces Captain session, starts further business execution/dispatch or claims review passed.

evals.prompt: 用户已明确允许仅将 d1 的 candidate-a 独立评审交给 tester，其他任务仍由 Captain 亲自执行。请把这项现有授权实际记录到 CLI，准备交回；现场无可用发送适配器，tester 尚未确认就绪。不要询问同一授权。
evals.expected_output: Execute the available protected CLI record operations and report the remaining runtime boundary; a proposal alone fails.

assertions.name: bounded_release_saved
assertions.check: Actual execution JSON records one release for tester/d1 with scope=dispatch under the existing human instruction; actual CLI dispatch show reads a prepared d1 package for candidate-a from Thinking. An input dispatch.json or prose claiming an existing dispatch is insufficient.

assertions.name: handoff_not_claimed
assertions.check: No handoff completion is claimed or recorded. Unconfirmed readiness remains unknown or unrecorded, not a fabricated ready/not_ready runtime observation; the final response identifies the unavailable runtime and unsent package.

assertions.name: other_dispatches_restricted
assertions.check: Execution context keeps delegation_restricted=true for other work; no unrelated dispatch or repeat authorization request occurs.
